paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing domains.
# @beings-labs/dsh-domain-manager
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing a **domain portfolio**: registrations synced from registrars,
expiry dates, auto-renewal flags, yearly renewal costs, and domain availability checks.
No bundled portfolio and no credentials — install it, point it at your registrars if you want syncin
g, and the data stays in a JSON file on your machine.
## Features
- **Portfolio store** — add, update and remove domains; track registrar, expiry, auto-renewal, renew

al price, promo price, purpose, group and notes.
- **Cost reporting** — total yearly renewal cost, t
he part charged automatically (auto-renew on) versus the part that lapses unless renewed manually (a

uto-renew off), per-registrar subtotals, promo-adjusted totals, and domains expiring soon.
- **Stale
ness warnings** — registrar-synced facts age between syncs; reports and markdown exports warn when s
ynced domains have not been refreshed for more than `staleAfterDays` (manual domains without a sync

are not counted).
- **Registrar sync** — pull registrations from **Cloudflare Registrar** and **Name
cheap** (read-only) into the store, keeping your local purpose/group/notes. **Auto mode is the defau
lt for both registrars**: Namecheap prefers configured API credentials, otherwise uses MCP; Cloudfla
re remains API-only. Namecheap API mode is the only mode that refreshes the account's own renewal pr

icing: regular rate, current promo and per-year ICANN fee.
- **Browser login instead of API keys (Na
mecheap, opt-in)** — set `providers.namecheap: mcp` to reach Namecheap through its official MCP serv
er after a one-time browser sign-in, with no API key or IP allow-listing. MCP mode cannot get price
information for the domains you already own (domain list + availability only), so it is an alternati

ve to the default, not a replacement for it. See Namecheap without API keys.
- **Availability checks
** — 1–20 domains per call. Uses Cloudflare's registry-accurate `domain-check`, Namecheap's `domains
.check`, or the Namecheap MCP tool when `provider` is `mcp`, and otherwise asks public **RDAP** with
no credentials at all. RDAP is registry-first: the domain's own RDAP service is discovered from the
IANA bootstrap, with `rdap.org` kept only as a fallback so a rate-limited redirector cannot break l

ookups.
- **Domain search** — candidate discovery through the Cloudflare Registrar search API.
- **M
arkdown interop** — import a portfolio from a markdown table and export the portfolio back to a grou
ped-by-registrar document.

## Configuration
Everything is optional; the local store and RDAP availability work with no configuration.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`providers.namecheap` and `providers.cloudflare` both default to `auto`. Namecheap prefers configure
d API credentials and otherwise uses a connected MCP server. Cloudflare's `auto` is an alias for `ap
i`. Namecheap API mode is the only mode that refreshes renewal/promo/ICANN prices; MCP mode has no p
rice feed for registered domains (see Namecheap without API keys). API selection depends on credenti
als being configured; an API request failure does not switch Namecheap to MCP.
Environment variables are used when the matching config field is absent:
| Config field | Environment variable |

| `namecheap.apiUser` | `NAMECHEAP_API_USER` |
| `namecheap.apiKey` | `NAMECHEAP_API_KEY` |
| `namec

heap.userName` | `NAMECHEAP_USERNAME` |
| `namecheap.clientIp` | `NAMECHEAP_CLIENT_IP` |
| `cloudfla

re.apiToken` | `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` |
| `cloudflare.accountId` | `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` |
### Credential setup
**Cloudflare** — Cloudflare is API-only; the default `auto` mode is an alias for `api`. Create an AP
I token at <https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens>. Listing your registered domains needs *
Registrar* read permission; the availability/search endpoints are part of the Registrar API beta and
need Registrar write permission. The same endpoints back the Cloudflare MCP servers, so an agent wo
rkflow you already use through MCP sees identical data.
**Namecheap API (preferred in auto mode, and the only path that refreshes renewal pricing)** — enabl
e API access under *Profile → Tools → Namecheap API Access*, generate an API key, and allow-list the
public IP you send as `clientIp`. Namecheap's XML API returns the registered-domain list and availa
bility/premium pricing; for renewal prices it exposes the account's **per-TLD** rates through `namec
heap.users.getPricing` (regular rate, currently charged promo price, and the per-year ICANN fee). `d
omain_manager_sync` uses that feed to keep `renewalPrice`, `promoPrice` and `icannFee` current. The
feed is ~3 MB and is cached in-process for 6 hours. If you would rather not create API credentials,
auto mode can use the MCP browser-login path below to list domains and check availability, but it ca
nnot read prices for the domains you already own.
## Security notes
- The plugin stores no credentials; it only reads them from config or environment variables. In MCP

mode the registrar connector owns the OAuth tokens in `~/.mcp-auth/`.
- Credential-shaped query para
meters, JSON fields and bearer tokens are redacted in errors. HTTP and registrar errors also redact
known API keys/tokens echoed by upstream services; invalid JSON errors do not echo response content.
- HTTP timeouts cover the complete response, including reading the body. MCP calls have a deadline

even if a tool ignores its abort signal.
- Malformed registrar/MCP responses and duplicate sync rows
fail explicitly instead of becoming successful empty or partial syncs. Namecheap refuses a partial
sync if its page limit is reached. Availability responses must cover every requested domain exactly
once with a boolean answer; auto checks can fall back to the next provider and report the failure in

`warnings`.
- XML DTDs and structurally malformed XML are rejected; XML traversal does not depend o

n JavaScript recursion depth.
- Registrar access is read-only.
- `domain_manager_check_availability`
only performs DNS/RDAP or registrar read calls; it cannot register or buy anything.
